verdict.rationale: Analysts can attach evidence files in a case's Files tab and add notes in the case Comments section. An automatic audit trail covers all work, and case history exports include comments. Recording decision reasons is supported only by the marketing claim that every decision is kept defensible, with no documented field or workflow for it. Missing for 10: a documented decision-reason or disposition-rationale capture, explicit documentation that evidence and notes appear in a per-case investigation timeline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can record evidence, notes and decision reasons in the investigation history

citations.quote: You can add one or more attachments (bulk import) in the Files tab from within a case
you could @-mention your selected reviewers in the Comments section
